finding.base_v5_claim: The original plan describes a deployed TTS gateway, but the current MedZen speech-platform repository and its dedicated ECR repository contain no implementation.
finding.conclusion: The MedZen speech-platform TTS service is not built. It must not be described as reusable completed code.

separate_existing_service.name: medzen-tts-gateway
separate_existing_service.reason: The owner explicitly excluded the separately owned repository and ECS service from this project.

b6a_decision.claim: B6A proves artifact loading and ASR serving only; it is not a full voice-conversation deployment.

future_full_b6.required_action: Build a new medzen-speech-tts-gateway owned by this repository, or obtain a new owner-approved integration decision.
